description: This PHP class file defines the tlRestApi class which implements a RESTful API for a test management system, including methods for managing test projects, test plans, test cases, builds, keywords, and platforms. The class manages authentication, request handling, and interactions with underlying data managers, and uses the Slim framework for routing.

classes.name: tlRestApi
classes.description: This class implements the REST API endpoints for a test management system, handling CRUD operations for projects, plans, test cases, builds, keywords, and platforms, with user authentication and request validation.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs user authentication based on API key or HTTP auth headers.

methods.name: whoAmI
methods.description: Returns the name of the class as a simple identification endpoint.

methods.name: superman
methods.description: Returns a fixed message, possibly for testing.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieves a list of accessible test projects, optionally by ID or prefix.

methods.name: getProjectTestPlans
methods.description: Fetches all test plans associated with a specified test project.

methods.name: getProjectTestCases
methods.description: Returns the latest version info for test cases under a test project.

methods.name: createTestProject
methods.description: Creates a new test project from JSON request body.

methods.name: createTestPlan
methods.description: Creates a new test plan from JSON request body.

methods.name: updateTestPlan
methods.description: Updates an existing test plan identified by ID.

methods.name: createTestSuite
methods.description: Creates a new test suite from JSON request body.

methods.name: createTestCase
methods.description: Creates a new test case, processing steps and attributes, from JSON request body.

methods.name: createBuild
methods.description: Creates a new build for a specified test plan, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: updateBuild
methods.description: Updates an existing build with new information, with validation.

methods.name: addPlatformsToTestPlan
methods.description: Links platforms to a test plan after validation.

methods.name: createKeyword
methods.description: Creates a new keyword associated with a test project.

methods.name: getPlanBuilds
methods.description: Retrieves all builds linked to a specific test plan identified by its API key.

methods.name: byeHTTP500
methods.description: Outputs a 500 error response with optional message and exits.

methods.name: msgFromException
methods.description: Extracts message and line info from an exception object.
